remarks: Patio Homes at Miller's Crossing! Stunning new Patio homes to be built. Condo status for reduced property taxes. HOA includes landscaping and snow plowing. As you step into the Verona, you’re greeted by the foyer, situated at the front. This area provides access to both the main entrance and the garage. Conveniently positioned adjacent to the foyer and garage is the laundry/mudroom. Across from this space lies the dining room, kitchen, and great room seamlessly interconnected, perfect for hosting gatherings. Moving to the left side of the house, you’ll discover the first bedroom, main bathroom, and the spacious primary suite. The primary suite comprises a generously sized bedroom, a luxurious bathroom, and two walk-in closets. Towards the rear of the house, you’ll encounter the office and covered porch area. Connected to the great room is a staircase guiding you up to the optional loft. This area features a generously sized room and a full bathroom, with the possibility of including a walk-in closet as an added option. Build your new Natale patio home today. This home is TO BE BUILT.
